subject: Separation planning — Samuel Turner (SWE II)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Separation recommendation: Samuel Turner (SWE II)

Team —

After today’s calibration and the closed-loop review of Samuel Turner’s performance file, I’m recommending we move forward with an involuntary separation. Summary points: 

- Role: Software Engineer II, Eng - Platform (managed by Marcus).
- Primary issues: repeated missed delivery commitments (Q4 2025–Q1 2026), failure to close P1 bug in a timely manner (recorded incident 2026-02-11), and multiple documented missed 1:1s after coaching plan initiated 2026-01-05.
- Attempts at remediation: 30/60 day PIP-like coaching plan, weekly checkpoints with Marcus. Documentation attached (performance_documentation.pdf).

Recommended separation details for leadership/legal approval:
- Service end date (target): 2026-04-28 (one week notice to allow knowledge transfer where feasible).
- Proposed severance: 4 weeks base pay, continuation of health benefits through end of severance period.
- Conditions: execution of standard severance agreement + mutual release; return of company equipment within 5 business days.

Risks/notes: Samuel has raised concerns informally about manager communication; Marcus can speak to current status and any mitigation. We should plan a short manager/HR/Legal prep call before any outreach.

Attachments: performance_documentation.pdf (contains dated coaching notes, missed milestones, and 1:1 logs).

Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Separation recommendation: Samuel Turner (SWE II)

Thanks Laura — I agree with the factual summary; adding context from my side: 

- Samuel’s delivery misses were concentrated on the migration of the KV cache handler (tickets ENG-1781, ENG-1824). He missed two emergent deadlines, which forced us to rollback a canary.
- He responded well to technical coaching initially but regressed in accountability over last two months. He has not accepted support offers to pair more consistently.
- There is one outstanding item: Samuel claims there was a lack of clarity on ownership for ENG-1781. I have written notes that clarify ownership but we should expect him to push back.

If we proceed, I recommend we offer the 4-week severance and include an explicit clause about return of devices and revocation of remote creds on the separation date. We should also prepare a short FAQ for the eng team to avoid rumors.

On logistics: I can run a 30–45 minute knowledge-transfer session this week (recorded). Happy to join the manager/HR/Legal prep call — my calendar is open Wed 11–12 or Thu 2–4 PT.

Thanks — legal sign-off items and edits below. I’ve attached a redlineable severance_template.docx. Key points: 

- Severance amount: 4 weeks base is reasonable; ensure calculation method (gross vs net) is explicit.
- Mutual release: include standard mutual release language and a 21-day review period before execution (best practice, but we can shorten if business-critical, note this may impact enforceability).
- COBRA/benefits continuation: spell out carrier contact and effective dates.
- IP/Confidentiality: add a targeted reminder about proprietary code and a narrow non-disparagement clause.
- Access revocation: recommend we schedule credential revocation at noon on the separation date (SFB) and coordinate with IT (on-site-it@securepick.com) for badge decommissioning.

Operational ask: please confirm the separation date and whether we want to ask Samuel to come on-site for HR/IT handoff or do a remote process. If on-site, let me know and I’ll loop in outsidecounsel for any day-of presence.

Attachment: severance_template.docx

—Dev

Senior Counsel, Employment

Team — thank you for the quick turnaround. I’m authorizing the separation with the following plan: 

1) Separation date: 2026-04-28, effective EOD.
2) Offer: 4 weeks severance (gross), benefits through the severance period, and standard mutual release. Dev — please prepare the doc for signature and send a DocuSign link; Laura, please attach the performance packet to the DocuSign envelope for reference.
3) Access & devices: IT to revoke remote access at 12:00 PM PT on 4/28. On-site vendor (on-site-it@securepick.com) to collect laptop and badge within 3 business days. Stephanie — please confirm pickup cadence and add badge_decomm_checklist.xlsx to the ticket.
4) Manager engagement: Marcus to run the recorded knowledge-transfer session Thu 4/23 2:00 PM PT and create a short summary for the team. Avoid technical details that could inflame the situation.
5) Communication: We will do a brief, factual note to the immediate team after the separation is complete; HR will handle wording.
6) Preparation meeting: 30 mins Thu 4/23 10:00 AM PT with Laura, Dev, Marcus, and me to finalize talking points.

Attachments (for internal records only): severance_agreement_v2.pdf; badge_decomm_checklist.xlsx

Please confirm you have the items and can meet Thu 10:00.

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
